title: Claude Code Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for plugins/<name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json files in the SDLC marketplace.

name.description: Unique plugin name. Lowercase, alphanumeric + hyphens.

description.description: One-paragraph description shown in marketplace listings.

dependencies.description: Native Claude Code install-time dependencies: plugins that must be installed AND enabled for this one to function. Claude Code itself also accepts "name@marketplace" strings and {name, marketplace, version, sha} objects (cross-marketplace, transitive, auto-enabling); this marketplace restricts itself by policy to bare same-marketplace names, which is what the pattern below enforces. An OPTIONAL, degradable dependency belongs in runtime-dependencies.json with policy: warn instead — a native dependency cannot be optional (ADR-0028).
